text:
marta_pm: Short thread 181818 we need 3 design partners for an 8-week Private+Dedic pilot: goals = validate routing failover, KMS integration, and the feedback/rollout contract. Shortlist + screening by Tue.

oleg_se: I'll build a tiny quickstart + a tracing shim for fallback events. ETA Thu. Will also add a small dashboard showing path decisions.

nina_ops: Ops checklist: confirm network path (peering/VPN/hosted-edge), IP allowlist, KMS test key, and an on-call contact. I can handle two peering setups.

lee_research: Acceptance metrics we should advertise: p95 latency target (we'll set exact ms once prompts locked), fallback incident rate <= 1% over pilot, integration <= 3 dev-days, and automated eval pass >= 90% for extraction tasks.

sasha_sales: Incentives proposal: $6k credits + priority Dedicated for 10 weeks + engineering office hours. Offer a short case study note post-pilot if partner is interested.

marta_pm: Draft screening q's (add/edit): ```
1) QPS and avg token length?
2) KMS vendor + any rotation policy?
3) Data residency requirements?
4) Network option: VPC peering, VPN, or hosted-edge?
5) Internal approver for rollout?
6) One sample prompt + expected output?
```
Add anything else?

oleg_se: Add: "Can you ingest a test trace header?" Also sample curl to trigger fallback:```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-route-1","prompt":"trigger fallback","timeout_ms":800}'
```
This will force timeout path and emit routing logs.

legal-bot: Use DP NDA v2026-03-02: https://redwood.docs/nda-dp. Use Beta variant. :white_check_mark:

marta_pm: Owners: @sasha_sales outreach, @oleg_se quickstart + SDK, @nina_ops infra, @lee_research metrics & prompts. Timeline: shortlist Tue, invites Wed, onboarding quickstart live Thu. Will track in the shared sheet.

sasha_sales: I'll target 3 warm leads and 3 colder prospects. Will include acceptance criteria and MOU in outreach.

marta_pm: One more: success = 2/3 partners meet p95 target and integration <=3 dev-days and no critical security blockers. If met, expand to 15-cust private beta. If not, iterate on SDK/infra.

oleg_se: I'll post the repo link and a 2-min demo when ready.

nina_ops: I'll upload infra checklist and rollback playbook (auto-split traffic to hosted if p95 breached for 15m).

marta_pm: Thanks all 181818 update the sheet when you take actions.
